notes.endagala: Ebikoora, banana leaves for wrapping food.
notes.webale-okufumba: Thank the cook after every meal.

guidebook.intro: Cook a meal step by step: follow instructions, name the tools and ingredients and enjoy the food.

tips.title: Steps in order
body: Recipes are a series of commands: **Banza** (first), **Shara obutungulu** (cut the onions), **Ta omu nyungu** (put it in the pot), **Yongyeramu omwonyo** (add salt), **Karanga** (fry).
When the food is ready: **Turye!** (let’s eat). Thank the cook with **Webale kuteeka**.

culture.title: Steamed in leaves
body: Matooke is peeled, wrapped in banana leaves, **ebikoora**, and steamed for hours in a pot before it is mashed. Thanking the cook is never skipped.
